verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo down to only a grinning mouth and cheek, so the face and the hero image are gone. Both also shrink the headline to small text in the middle, with the podcast credit nearly as large, so the headline barely stands out. A also puts the question-mark doodle right on the subject's mouth/teeth, a clear collision. B moves the bulb, atom and question-mark doodles into a cramped cluster beside the text instead, and keeps them off the face, so it is the less broken of the two.
